description: This file defines the ElvisBinary class, a node representing the Elvis operator (?:) in Twig's abstract syntax tree, used for inline conditional expressions in templates.

classes.name: ElvisBinary
classes.description: Represents the Elvis operator (?:) within Twig's internal expression node tree, enabling inline conditional logic in Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ElvisBinary node with left and right expressions and sets test node and attribute.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code implementing the Elvis operator logic during template compilation.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator symbol used in the compiled PHP code, i.e., '?:'.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the list of operand node names ('left', 'right') that should be escaped.
